reviews.text:
RUN AWAY WITH YOUR CAT!
The owner and entrance are neglected; the "jokes" are beyond inappropriate; the cat, normally calm according to its owner, hisses continuously whenever it sees the owner (whom it knows).

I came to drop off a resume... and quickly took it with me.

🤮 (Unfortunately, I have to give it 1 star)

My cat, Atchoum, spent a week at Chat'hitel and everything went wonderfully!

It was a great opportunity for her to socialize while I was on vacation. Having a daily video of the rooms was very reassuring and allowed me to see that my cat was doing well.

Other big pluses: the place is remarkably clean and air-conditioned!
I highly recommend this place 😊

A huge thank you to Dominique!

We wanted to express our deepest gratitude to Dominique for taking such good care of Orléans while we were away. Knowing our beloved pet was in such good hands allowed us to enjoy our vacation with complete peace of mind.

Dominique is someone who loves animals with all his heart, and it shows in everything he does. His devotion to them is remarkable: he gives them attention, tenderness, and kindness with unwavering generosity.
Beyond his exceptional qualities with animals, Dominique is simply a wonderful person, incredibly kind and gentle.
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts, Dominique. Orléans was in the best possible hands!

On their website, there's a booking form to download and fill out. Before doing that, and to save myself some time, I called to check availability. The man on the other end told me I had to come in so we could "discuss" things. It's an hour's drive from my home to the cat hotel. Upon arrival, he told me I had to sign a three-day contract to get the cat used to the place, and that it was non-negotiable. He shoved the contract form in my face without even offering to show me around. Why didn't he tell me this over the phone? I think he was trying to force a sale. Besides, having boarded my cat at other catteries, I've never been required to do this. I hate this way of doing things. I wasted precious time when, if this information had been given to me over the phone, I would have saved two hours.

I entrusted my cat to this hotel for five years without any problems, and I was always satisfied until now. My cat always returned in his usual condition after each stay.

However, this summer, I picked up my cat emaciated, with significant weight and fur loss. On top of that, he smelled bad. When I asked about his condition, I was simply told, “I don’t know, I didn’t pay much attention to that room. It was a lady I was meeting for the first time. Dominique was out at the time.” The following days were worrying: my cat barely drank, stopped grooming himself, stopped purring, drooled, and seemed deeply stressed. He had also developed an unusual fear of certain everyday noises, particularly plastic bags. The vet confirmed his stress. I’m not trying to blame the hotel, as I don’t know what really happened. Perhaps my cat couldn’t handle the separation this time, which would have been a perfectly plausible explanation if I had been informed. They could have simply told me, “Your cat didn’t have a good stay,” “He was very stressed,” or “He may no longer tolerate separations.” He will no longer be able to be boarded there. Everyone expected it. But that wasn't the case, and it's precisely this lack of explanation that still fuels my questions today. Hence my one-star rating, which I just changed following a previous review.
After years of trust, getting my pet back in such a state is disappointing. I was especially worried and angry for my cat, to the point of not even trying to contact the hotel afterward. After this experience, I will be looking after my cat elsewhere.
The cats are welcomed like kings, but speak rudely to us, making inappropriate jokes.

Very clean and very well equipped.

For playful or adventurous cats, there are several daily activities under the watchful eye of Uncle Vincent....
Our cat is a bit older and needs rest and quiet. Each cat receives personalized attention and care for their well-being.
Every day, we receive a video and photos to keep us informed and reassured. I highly recommend this wonderful cattery.
We've been entrusting our two little ones to them for the summer and winter holidays for a good 3 years now. They are pampered there.

I was apprehensive, but I leave my cat Tina with my uncle without any problems. He loves cats, and she always comes back, and everything is fine. All the videos I see every day are great. I can see that my cat is treated very well.

That's essential for me.

I left my two cats, Olive and Ourson, with Dominique and I highly recommend her. Dominique reassured me completely; I was very stressed, and it was my first time. My cats were warmly welcomed and well cared for. Dominique has a heart of gold; I highly recommend her.

Thank you again, we will be back.

Laurine

Chachou was pampered.
Dominique is wonderful with cats, of course, but also with their owners. Perfect service.
We are very happy and highly recommend her. 😻

After spending 15 days at Dominique's, I found my two little ones in excellent health. The daily videos made for a wonderful holiday. So a big thank you to Uncle Dominique who knows how to take such good care of them.
A fantastic hotel, thank you again 😉☺️😁 …

Hello
I am delighted every year to entrust my cat to Dominique. I go on holiday with complete peace of mind, and the fact that he sends us videos every day allows us to see our cat. Cleanliness, kindness, safety, understanding, care, play, comfort – everything is perfect.
A fantastic team! Thank you to Dominique and Angelique for taking such good care of our Aïda. It's clear you're passionate about your work! See you soon!

Tichat has stayed with "Tonton" and his team several times. They take excellent care of her. She tried other hotels when we weren't living in Marseille. When I needed one here, Chat'hotel was recommended to me, and I'm more than happy with it. She's very comfortable there; she's stayed four times in just over six months, and she has two more bookings in 2025. I trust her completely. ☺️
Thank you for your feedback.

For the first time, I entrusted Tomy, my soon-to-be 3-year-old Siberian cat, to the "Le Rêve des Chats" cat hotel for 10 long days. I placed my complete trust in Dominique and Angélique, both passionate and highly professional! The well-being of their guests is clearly their priority. The premises are spacious, very clean, tastefully decorated, and peaceful, which is ideal for cats who might be stressed by this change of environment.

Dominique and Angélique took excellent care of him, even arranging a scheduled vet visit. I was able to get updates every day through videos posted daily on Facebook, and also by phone whenever needed!

Thank you to them! I highly recommend entrusting your beloved pet to the Le Rêve des Chats hotel/club 😻
The welcome was perfect for my cat! Impeccable hygiene and comfort, and a charming manager who knows cats very well. I highly recommend it.
Thank you for your feedback.

Our cat is always treated like royalty! Dominique is a true cat dad who understands and takes excellent care of his guests; you can tell he loves cats.

Plus, you can rely on the Cat'Hotel even at the last minute and still find a relaxed furball upon your return.
The hotel is constantly improving with new rooms featuring fantastic decor that are truly designed with cats in mind.
Thanks Florian. As usual, Ellie is a really sweet and very discreet little cat...
THANKS

We entrusted our cat to Dominique a few months ago. She's not the easiest cat to care for; she's quite grumpy and very attached to her owner. So we were a little worried about leaving her for a few days in an unfamiliar place. Dominique offered to show me around the hotel and reassured me about how well Ginger would adapt to a new environment. Ginger's stay went very well. She had her own room. Every evening, we could watch a short video on Facebook, and Dominique answered our questions by text message. In the end, we got Ginger back in perfect health. We will definitely repeat this experience and highly recommend this establishment.
Thank you, Dominique, for your warm welcome and excellent follow-up.

Thank you to Dominique for taking such good care of our little Neige, who will be 19 soon. We were able to leave for a few days with complete peace of mind. She came home calm and healthy. The daily videos are lovely...
Never replied.

My cat had a ten-day stay. With Dominique, cats are pampered. The house is clean and professional. The ideal solution for a stress-free holiday with your cat in a hotel. My cat was so comfortable and at ease that he was happy. I recommend it 200%!
Mimi, our cat whom I adopted five months ago, was placed at the Hotel Club for a three-day settling-in period. Today I went to pick her up, and I found her so much calmer—a real change! …

A huge thank you again for Caline's stay in this beautiful new setting with lots of hiding places... The daily videos to follow your little one's stay are always lovely... I picked her up in great shape and even more talkative and cuddly... see you very soon!
